steps.description:
Create a turtle screen and a pen. Draw an "L" shape of any length.

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)
steps.answer:
import turtle
myscreen = turtle.Screen()
mypen = turtle.Turtle()
mypen.forward(100)
mypen.left(90)
mypen.forward(100)
